title: •Gambler’s Luck
caption: •Gambler’s Luck (V)
game_text: During opponent’s control phase, if your gambler on table, use 1 Force. Both players draw three destiny. Winner (higher total destiny) may target one opponent’s character with a printed power matching one of the winner’s destiny draws. Target is lost.
